scope: Any canonical CNF state and any live pivot variable x under the frozen eliminate_var_capped semantics.

definitions.R: state_units of clauses retaining neither +x nor -x

lemma.name: GENERIC_PRE_SUBSUMPTION_RAW_ELIMINATION_UPPER_BOUND
lemma.statement: For frozen eliminate_var_capped(F,x,cap), the monotone raw accumulator can never exceed B_x = R + p*q + q*U_plus + p*U_minus. Therefore B_x<=cap is a deterministic sufficient certificate that exact elimination of x cannot abort from the raw cap.
proof: The raw accumulator begins with exactly the retained clauses, whose state_units contribution is R.

There are at most p*q parent pairs. For a positive parent C+=(x OR A) and negative parent C-=(-x OR B), the exact resolvent is canon_clause(A union B). If it is tautological it contributes zero; if duplicate it contributes zero additional raw units.
Otherwise its length is at most |A|+|B|. Its raw state-unit increment is therefore at most 1+|A|+|B|.
Summing the constant 1 over all p*q possible parent pairs contributes p*q.
Every positive tail A participates in q pairs, so all positive-tail lengths contribute at most q*U_plus. Every negative tail B participates in p pairs, contributing at most p*U_minus.

Thus the total monotone raw accumulator is bounded by R+p*q+q*U_plus+p*U_minus. Because eliminate_var_capped only aborts when this monotone accumulator exceeds cap, B_x<=cap guarantees no raw-cap abort.

No appeal to tautology frequency, duplicate frequency, subsumption, heuristic score, SAT semantics, or future information is needed. Those effects can only reduce the actual raw/canonical result relative to the bound.

equivalent_whole_state_form.derivation: Each pivot-containing clause C contributes one clause unit plus |C|=1+(1+tail), hence 2+tail. Removing all p+q pivot clauses from s leaves R.

edge_cases.p_zero_or_q_zero: Then p*q and the corresponding cross terms vanish; elimination is pure deletion and the formula reduces to the retained-state size.
edge_cases.tautological_resolvents: Ignored by the upper bound and therefore only help.
edge_cases.duplicate_resolvents: Ignored by the upper bound and therefore only help.
edge_cases.canonical_subsumption: Occurs after raw charging in the frozen engine and is not used to justify safety.

algorithmic_certificate.computation: Single scan of clauses to obtain p,q,U_plus,U_minus,R for a specified pivot.
algorithmic_certificate.authority: Sufficient cap certificate only. If B_x>cap, actual elimination may still succeed because the bound can overcount tautologies/duplicates; rejection is therefore UNKNOWN/NO_CERTIFICATE, not proof of overflow.

lemma.next_exact_target: Compose this one-pivot bound sequentially across a v3 B2 macro: certify first old pivot, materialize its exact capped output, then certify a second distinct old pivot and strict root-free progress.
